Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 560bfe774f058e97596f30ff71cffdac52b72914 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Maxime Ripard <maxime.ripard@free-electrons.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Nov 2017 16:47:08 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: sun8i-codec: Invert Master / Slave condition

The current code had the condition backward when checking if the codec
should be running in slave or master mode.

Fix it, and make the comment a bit more readable.

Fixes: 36c684936fae ("ASoC: Add sun8i digital audio codec")
Signed-off-by: Maxime Ripard <maxime.ripard@free-electrons.com>
Reviewed-by: Chen-Yu Tsai <wens@csie.org>
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>

diff --git a/sound/soc/sunxi/sun8i-codec.c b/sound/soc/sunxi/sun8i-codec.c
index abfb710df7cb..038107baf414 100644
--- a/sound/soc/sunxi/sun8i-codec.c
+++ b/sound/soc/sunxi/sun8i-codec.c
@@ -170,11 +170,11 @@ static int sun8i_set_fmt(struct snd_soc_dai *dai, unsigned int fmt)
 
 	/* clock masters */
 	switch (fmt & SND_SOC_DAIFMT_MASTER_MASK) {
-	case SND_SOC_DAIFMT_CBS_CFS: /* DAI Slave */
-		value = 0x0; /* Codec Master */
+	case SND_SOC_DAIFMT_CBS_CFS: /* Codec slave, DAI master */
+		value = 0x1;
 		break;
-	case SND_SOC_DAIFMT_CBM_CFM: /* DAI Master */
-		value = 0x1; /* Codec Slave */
+	case SND_SOC_DAIFMT_CBM_CFM: /* Codec Master, DAI slave */
+		value = 0x0;
 		break;
 	default:
 		return -EINVAL;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `sound/soc/sunxi/sun8i-codec.c`**
- The condition for determining whether the codec should operate in master or slave mode has been inverted.
- The comments associated with the cases in the switch statement have been updated for clarity:
  - The case for `SND_SOC_DAIFMT_CBS_CFS` was changed from indicating "DAI Slave" and "Codec Master" to "Codec slave, DAI master".
  - The case for `SND_SOC_DAIFMT_CBM_CFM` was changed from indicating "DAI Master" and "Codec Slave" to "Codec Master, DAI slave".
- The values assigned to `value` in these cases have been swapped:
  - For `SND_SOC_DAIFMT_CBS_CFS`, the value is now set to `0x1` (indicating codec slave).
  - For `SND_SOC_DAIFMT_CBM_CFM`, the value is now set to `0x0` (indicating codec master).

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in the `sun8i-codec.c` file are directly related to fixing a logical error in the codec's operation mode. The inversion of the condition ensures that the codec correctly identifies its role (master or slave) based on the DAI format specified. The changes in comments enhance the readability and understanding of the code, making it clearer for future developers what each case represents. This patch addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (identified by the Fixes tag), ensuring that the codec operates correctly in audio data interface configurations.
